title: crassula × flexa
intro: Crassula × flexa, commonly known as the 'Jade Plant', is a hybrid succulent plant resulting from the cross-pollination between Crassula ovata and Crassula arborescens. This plant is valued for its air-purifying properties and is often used in indoor spaces to promote a healthier environment. Research has shown that Crassula × flexa possesses health benefits due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to lower blood pressure, reduce stress, and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have been reported to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects.
